title: Add a certificate to a keychain
summary: Import a certificate file into a specific keychain. If no keychain is specified, it is added to the default keychain.

steps.explain: Add a certificate from a file to a specific keychain.

placeholders.name: KEYCHAIN_PATH
placeholders.description: The path to the keychain file where the certificate should be added.

placeholders.name: CERT_FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the certificate file (e.g., .pem or .cer).

alternatives.explain: Add the certificate to the default keychain by omitting the -k flag.
